gloss: half in doubt; skeptical; not fully convinced

definitions.gloss: half in doubt; skeptical; not fully convinced
definitions.explanation: A state of being partly convinced and partly doubtful about something. Used when someone cannot fully believe or disbelieve what they have heard or experienced.

examples.japanese: {半信半疑|はんしんはんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{半信半疑|はんしんはんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受|う}け{止|と}めた→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧。
examples.english: I took the story with a grain of salt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{半信半疑|はんしんはんぎ}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{納得|なっとく}した→納得する：26805_nattokusuru⟧。
examples.english: At first I was skeptical, but after seeing it for myself, I was convinced.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom) describing a state of mixed belief and doubt. The word literally means 'half belief, half doubt' — the person wants to believe but cannot shake their uncertainty.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half) + {信|しん} (belief) + ⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half) + {疑|ぎ} (doubt)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半信半疑|はんしんはんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to listen with skepticism
- {半信半疑|はんしんはんぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受|う}け{止|と}める→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧: to take something with mixed feelings
- {半信半疑|はんしんはんぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: while still half in doubt

USAGE:
Often used adverbially with で to describe how someone receives information or takes action. Commonly appears when describing reactions to surprising news, unlikely stories, or unverified claims.
